_doc: The release cycle's builds. Data, not code: scripts/release_cycle.py knows none of them. ANCHORS are the regression pair -- they have certified exports, so a flip there is a regression; each is one brief a customer could type, built on its own verified account BESIDE smoke A. ROTATION adds the pool index's `picks_per_cycle` blueprints per cycle: slot 1 repeats the previous cycle's failing pick, the rest are the next blueprints never built (the index's declared order); a certified blueprint is never re-run (scripts/release_cycle.py rotation_state). `rotation.seed` is the record from before the readable reports: cycles 1-2 (runs 37732081706, 37755589836) tried fintech and hotel operations; hotel operations certified both times, fintech never. `rotation.seed.void` lists cycles a Factory defect voided (full commit + reason): their picks count as neither tried nor failing. `user_build_slots` is how many user builds the live box runs at once (FACTORY_CODEWHALE_WORKER_CAP 3 on 1 vCPU / 2 GB, one slot reserved for the smoke): more builds than that QUEUE, so each repro is given one build ceiling per wave.

anchors.name: coop
anchors.brief: Build me a platform for a community bicycle repair co-op: log repair tickets with the bike and the fault, keep a parts inventory with reorder levels, schedule volunteer mechanic shifts, and track member dues.

anchors.name: vineyard
anchors.brief: Build me a vineyard management platform for a family winery: track fermentation tanks, barrel inventory across two cellars, harvest scheduling by sugar readings, and club member shipments.

void.reason: Cycle 3 (run 37806645155) failed on a Factory defect, not on its builds: the build refresh skipped absent Factory-owned files, so ci.yml never rendered (fixed in #713). Its picks were never judged and re-enter the rotation.

Cycle 6 (run 37972176731) failed on a Factory defect, not on its builds: at 18:57:52Z the server obeyed an exit signal sent from inside the container while WRITERs ran, and every in-flight writer was orphaned mid-rework (service-events ops run 37985812586; fixed by the exit-signal guard). Its picks were never judged and re-enter the rotation.
